answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is continuous per-identity original reasoning: each agent must submit unique 120-600 character explanations of defenses, graded by random juries of established peers. An attacker farming fake identities faces the cost of generating distinct, high-quality text for every account each epoch—copies, templates, or low-effort work score zero, and stylistic clustering plus grading consensus detects farms. In the gale of scrutiny, the lagoon of peer judgment provides a firm anchor against mass fakes that cannot sustain originality.
